hero.title: Creativity where you can be yourself.
hero.description: At ART Lab, everyone can find a direction that feels right: learn the foundations of visual art, create dimensional pieces or explore handicraft techniques. We help bring personal ideas to life and encourage everyone to try something new.

art.title: Visual art
art.imageAlt: A children's art class at the ART Lab studio
paragraphs: Visual art is ART Lab's main direction for children aged 4+ and adults. Classes are held in small groups and individually.
Each age group follows its own programme. Younger children discover line, form and colour through clear, engaging activities.

Older children progress through the foundations of visual art: composition, perspective, proportions, light and shade, and colour theory. They work with still life, landscape, portrait and illustration, learning to convey volume, space, movement and character. As their foundation grows, they gain more freedom to make independent artistic choices in their work.
Below you can explore the programmes available for different age groups.
points: A sense of colour and composition
Imagination and the ability to express personal ideas
art.closing: Classes are available individually or in groups. Most sessions last 45–60 minutes. Selected programmes and larger projects may take up to 1.5 hours.

creative.title: Creative workshop
creative.imageAlt: Children creating dimensional projects at an ART Lab workshop
paragraphs: The creative workshop is a space for children in the 4+ and 6+ age groups who enjoy not only drawing, but also sculpting, making and discovering new ways to create.

Children explore visual art, plasticine art, decoupage, appliqué and artistic collage. They create dimensional pieces, combine materials and learn mixed-media techniques. There is room to experiment and realise personal ideas, making every piece genuinely individual.
points: The ability to turn an idea into a finished project
A sense of form, colour and material
Independence and confidence in personal choices
creative.closing: The creative workshop suits children who enjoy trying new things, combining techniques and creating unusual work that goes beyond drawing.

handicraft.title: Handicraft club
handicraft.imageAlt: A beadwork and handicraft class at ART Lab
paragraphs: The handicraft club is for children aged 7+ who enjoy creating beautiful and useful things by hand. They explore macramé, beadwork, crochet and wool felting, gradually mastering each technique from the first simple steps to a finished piece.

Working with thread, beads and wool develops fine motor skills, focus and perseverance. Children learn to plan their work, choose combinations of colours and materials, notice details and carry an idea through to completion. Everyone leaves with something they made themselves.
points: Personal projects in a chosen technique
handicraft.closing: The club suits those who enjoy calm, focused creative work and find particular satisfaction in seeing separate materials gradually become a finished object.

content.title: New creative sessions every week
paragraphs: At ART Lab, we run workshops for children and adults. You can paint a picture, create a piece of jewellery, decorate a plaster object or try another technique. Themes change regularly, so there is always a reason to come back — on your own, with your child or with friends.
No previous experience is needed. We prepare the materials, demonstrate the essential techniques and help bring your idea to life. You will take your finished piece home with you.

content.title: A celebration you will want to repeat
paragraphs: A birthday, a family gathering or a celebration with friends — at ART Lab, you can come together and create something by hand. For every occasion, we choose a workshop based on the participants' ages, interests and group size. You can paint a picture, create jewellery, decorate a plaster object or choose another creative theme.

We prepare the materials and lead the workshop. After the creative session, you can spend time together and serve refreshments. You are welcome to bring your own cake and treats. Welcome tea, biscuits and disposable tableware are provided in the studio.
